title: cyclamen alpinum f. leucanthum
intro: Cyclamen alpinum f. leucanthum, commonly known as the Alpine White Cyclamen, is a type of flowering plant in the barbolineae subfamily. This plant is known for its delicate white flowers and heart-shaped leaves. The Alpine White Cyclamen has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety, making it a popular choice for those seeking natural stress relief. Its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and glycosides, may have therapeutic actions such as sedation and anti-inflammatory effects, contributing to its potential health benefits.
